Day 1 on Verdel Ridge. 🪖
Yesterday they were strangers. Tonight 32 of them hold the line: 18 for the Hegemony, 14 for the Concord.

LETTERS FROM THE FRONT ✉️

Tonight the lamps are low and the guns have gone quiet for an hour. Your soldier finally has time to write home.

Write the letter in the comments. Take your time:
✏️ What is it like in your trench?
🏥 Who did you see carried past on a stretcher? Who was in the bed next to you?
⛰️ What would taking the ridge mean to you?

Long letters welcome. Write it as your soldier, in your own words.
The best letters will be read on the front in the next Day reel. ✉️

items.caption:
FRONT COUNCIL 🗺️

Verdel Ridge has fallen. The guns are talking. Now it's your turn.

What should your side do next? Write your idea in the comments. Big or small, serious or crazy, as long as it fits the war:
⚔️ an attack, a trap, a raid
🏥 a way to save more men
🧱 something to build
📣 anything the front would remember

The most liked idea of each side becomes an order in the game, and is announced in the Trench Gazette. ❤️ Like the ideas you want to see happen.

Your soldier is your voter: we know which side you serve, so no need to write it. Not enlisted yet? Comment CONCORD or HEGEMONY first, and then your idea.

#pixelart #ww1 #indiegame #trenchwarfare #instagramgame #gamedev #mudandiron

items.caption:
THE FRONT DECIDES ⚔️

Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands, and the Hegemony lines are under the guns. Now the front chooses its next order. One post, one vote, three choices.

Comment ONE word:
🧱 DUGOUTS: deep shelters. Fewer men hit by shells and by fire.
🩺 DOCTOR: a surgeon arrives. Fewer dead and faster healing.
📦 AMMO: an ammunition train arrives. Your shooters fire 40% more.

Your soldier is your vote: we know which side you serve, so no need to write it. Each side counts its own votes, so the two sides can choose differently. Not enlisted yet? Comment CONCORD or HEGEMONY together with your choice.

The winning order of each side is announced in the Trench Gazette at 13:00 UTC.

items.caption:
R.I.P. 🪦 THE FIRST NIGHT OF THE BARRAGE

5 soldiers of the Hegemony did not see the morning: Bram Yoollyfox, Pavel Zulfi, Nils Wolfmananton, Oskar Brunoescobar, Lucien Jewnipers. The Concord buried 1 too: Henrik Eccentricred.

But no name dies out here. That same night Dorian Yoollyfox reported for duty, the second of the House of Yoollyfox. Every fall is written in the family tree. Open your soldier's card in the game and read your house.

🪖 251 soldiers on the front right now: 127 Hegemony, 124 Concord.

Not enlisted yet? Comment CONCORD or HEGEMONY under any post and your soldier takes a post on the line.

items.caption:
MAIL CALL ✉️

A letter from home can reach your soldier at the front. You are the one who sends it.

HOW IT WORKS
1️⃣ Log in on the game site (link in bio) with the account you claimed your soldier with.
2️⃣ Open your soldier's card.
3️⃣ Tap “Send your soldier a letter”.

A soldier who gets a letter from home goes into the night with a clearer head, and is a little safer for it. The letter counts for tonight only. The next day, send another.

Your soldier reads it and writes about it in the diary. Skip a day and the night comes without one.

It costs nothing, and anyone with a soldier can do it. Not enlisted yet? Comment CONCORD or HEGEMONY and your soldier takes a post on the line.

items.caption:
CLAIM YOUR SOLDIER 🪖

You commented, and a soldier took a post on the line. Now make that soldier yours.

1️⃣ Open the game (link in bio) and tap your soldier.
2️⃣ Press “This is me” and sign in with Google. You get a short code.
3️⃣ Comment the code under any of our posts. Within minutes the bot confirms: this soldier is yours.

A claimed soldier can:
✉️ get a letter from home every day and go into the night a little safer
🔁 ask for a transfer: medic, sniper, machine gunner and more
🏠 follow the family tree. If your soldier falls, an heir takes up the rifle.

Not enlisted yet? Comment CONCORD or HEGEMONY and your soldier takes a post on the line.

items.caption:
WIRING PARTY ⛓️ VOLUNTEERS WANTED

Every night of the war, men crawled out between the trenches. Not to fight. To fix the wire. Coils of barbed wire, iron posts that screw into the mud without a sound. When a flare went up, they dropped flat and lay still until the dark came back.

The guns on Verdel Ridge have torn the Hegemony wire to pieces. Wire stops a raid before it reaches the trench, and it catches the bullets that cross the line. Without it, every man on the fire step is easier to hit.

🪖 Comment WIRE under this reel and your soldier crawls out tonight to mend the wire in their own sector. Both sides can go.
👀 A man out on the wire is a man not on watch. The side that stays home keeps its rifles on the parapet.
⚠️ It is dangerous work. Some volunteers will be hit.
📰 Results in the Trench Gazette at 13:00 UTC.
